text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: p99 latency alert fired for route /v1/generate in eu-west-1 - threshold 1200ms (current p99=2450ms). Auto-page level: P1. Link: https://ops.example.com/alerts/1799993333 :rotating_light:
alex-m: acked. I'm on it. Checking dashboards and recent deploys.
samira: i'm pulling up the tail traces now, looks like a surge of long requests pinned to model-runner-7.
lee: quick note — we rolled traffic-shaping experiment last night that routes by header x-llm-weight to large-variants. could be related.
alex-m: timeline check: no infra deploy in past 90m, but product routing change merged ~2h ago. will check router logs.
maria: metrics: tokens/sec for large-variants spiked 3x, request concurrency per instance ~48 (normal 12). KV cache miss rate jumped.
alex-m: runbook step 1: try fallback routing to smaller-quantized model. Samira, can you flip the routing flag?
samira: doing it now: /ops/feature-flags -> set header-routing=false
samira: command: curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" https://console.internal/api/flags/header-routing -d '{"enabled":false}'
samira: flag set. Waiting for rollout (~20s).
lee: observed immediate drop in large-variant traffic on edge metrics. p95 dropping but p99 still high.
alex-m: runbook step 2: scale up model-runner-7 to absorb in-flight work and avoid queueing. scaling +2 replicas. kubectl scale deployment model-runner-7 --replicas=6 -n inference
maria: scaled. new pods coming up, warmup logs show kv cache population starting.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by alex-m; escalation paused.
lee: suggesting transient token-bucket throttle on /v1/generate to cap bursty requests — small risk to some requests but reduces tail. anyone object?
alex-m: agree, apply 100rps global cap for 3m. ops-sre please apply.
maria: applied throttle via gateway: rate-limit /v1/generate 100rps burst=200 window=60s. monitoring.
lee: p95 ~ 420ms now, p99 down to ~980ms. still above 800ms target but trending down. good.
samira: traces show requests previously queuing in runner queue for >1.5s then executing. new runners reduce queue times.
alex-m: customer impact: internal dashboard shows 0.3% error increase (timeouts) and a handful of support tickets reporting slow load. low customer-impact but SLO burn qualifies P1.
lee: creating a short incident ticket and linking notes. ticket: INC-2026-3421.
alex-m: I'll stay on for next 20m to watch and then handoff to oncall-rotations. Maria, can you keep monitoring KV warm rate and p99?
maria: yes. will post updates every 5m or on regression.
alex-m: if p99 stays <900ms for 10m, we'll relax throttle and keep fallback routing for 1h.
samira: 5m update: p99=760ms, queue latency <200ms, new pods healthy.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Reminder - escalation policy will resume in 30m if alert re-fires.
alex-m: prepping handoff: oncall-rotations pls take this at 18:40 UTC. key actions: keep throttle in place, monitor p99, verify KV miss rate drops <5%.
oncall-rotations: taking it. thanks for triage notes — will reach out if it resurfaces.
alex-m: closing note: root cause suspected interaction between header-based routing experiment and model capacity planning; follow-up CR to revert or add autoscale safety limits. assigning to lee. :memo:
lee: acknowledged, will open a postmortem draft and schedule follow-up with product.
maria: last check before handoff: p99=680ms, errors normalizing. marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
